seoTitle: Roll Up Subitem Data in Monday.com to Parent Items
metaDescription: Summarize subitem costs, progress, and timelines onto parent rows in Monday.com using the Show Summary on Parent Item rollup feature.
intro: When a task has several subitems tracking hours, budget, or status, you don't want to check each one individually to see where things stand. Monday.com's rollup feature summarizes that subitem data directly onto the parent row. This guide covers setting it up and configuring what kind of summary you get.

steps.heading: Open your board's subitem columns
steps.body: Navigate to a board with existing subitems and access the subitem column customization directory.

steps.heading: Add tracking columns to subitems
steps.body: Add columns such as Numbers for hours or budgets, or Status for tracking task completion.

steps.heading: Turn on the rollup
steps.body: Open the subitem column's settings and click Show Summary on Parent Item to create the rollup.

steps.heading: Choose your rollup type
steps.body: Configure the parent-level settings to display sum, average, min, max, or count for numerical data.

steps.heading: Track progress visually
steps.body: Use the Rollup Status/Progress Bar on parent rows to see overall completion percentage across subtasks at a glance.

faq.question: How do I get subitem totals to show on the parent row?
faq.answer: Open the subitem column's settings and click Show Summary on Parent Item to enable the rollup.

faq.question: What kinds of rollup calculations are available?
faq.answer: You can configure sum, average, min, max, or count for numerical subitem data.

faq.question: Can I see subtask completion as a progress bar?
faq.answer: Yes, the Rollup Status/Progress Bar on parent rows visually tracks overall completion across all underlying subitems.

faq.question: Can I use rolled-up data in filters or automations?
faq.answer: Yes, rolled-up data can be used in board filters, automation recipes, and high-level KPI dashboards.
